items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had the late and great Rex Stewart playing cornet with me in Wilberforce.

ctx.x: He took the trumpet up, and he plays good trumpet, and he's an excellent arranger. He was excellent, and of course I had the late and great Rex Stewart playing cornet with me in Wilberforce. I took Rex to
Wilberforce. I took Benny Carter to Wilberforce.
